about_pullquote: We keep it simple: honest advice, quality products, and safe gas work.
about_para_1: Elswick DIY & SK Gas Engineering has been a trusted fixture on Elswick Road, Newcastle upon Tyne for well over a decade. We combine a fully stocked DIY and hardware store with a professional Gas Safe engineering service — giving homeowners, landlords, and tradespeople everything they need in one convenient location.
about_para_2: Our Gas Safe registered engineers bring skill and care to every job, whether it is a straightforward boiler service or a full central heating installation. Customers return to us time and again because they know they will get straight-talking advice, competitive prices, and work carried out to the highest safety standards.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant local shop — always have exactly what I need for odd jobs around the house. The lads are really helpful and never try to oversell you. Been coming here for years and wouldn't go anywhere else.
reviews.author: Craig T.

reviews.text: Had SK Gas come out to service my boiler and sort a faulty valve. Turned up on time, explained everything clearly, and the price was very fair. Gave me a Gas Safety certificate on the day too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Julie M.

reviews.text: Needed a gas cooker fitting at short notice and they fitted me in the next day. Really professional job, everything tested and certified. Great to have a proper local business you can actually trust.
reviews.author: David R.
